mapper.sql: select r.report_id, r.report_code, r.report_name, r.stat_month, r.region_code, r.report_status, r.metric_count, r.metric_amount, r.metric_rate, r.report_summary, r.attachment_url, r.source_mode, r.generated_time from t_stat_report r
mapper.select: where r.report_id = #{reportId} and r.del_flag = '0'

select item_id, report_id, item_category, item_name, item_dimension, metric_count, metric_value, metric_rate, sort_no from t_stat_report_item where report_id = #{reportId} order by sort_no asc, item_id asc
mapper.update: update t_stat_report set report_name = #{reportName}, report_status = #{reportStatus}, metric_count = #{metricCount}, metric_amount = #{metricAmount}, metric_rate = #{metricRate}, report_summary = #{reportSummary}, attachment_url = #{attachmentUrl}, source_mode = #{sourceMode}, generated_time = #{generatedTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime}, remark = #{remark} where report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.select:
select null as item_id, null as report_id, 'INJURY_RATE' as item_category, ie.region_code as item_name, ie.region_code as item_dimension, count(1) as metric_count, cast(( select count(1) from t_person p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.insurance_status = '1' and p.region_code = ie.region_code ) as decimal(16,2)) as metric_value, case when ( select count(1) from t_person p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.insurance_status = '1' and p.region_code = ie.region_code ) = 0 then 0 else round(count(1) / ( select count(1) from t_person p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.insurance_status = '1' and p.region_code = ie.region_code ) * 100, 2) end as metric_rate, 0 as sort_no from t_injury_event ie where date_format(ie.event_date, '%Y-%m') = #{statMonth} and ie.del_flag = '0'
and ie.region_code like concat(#{regionPrefix}, '%')
group by ie.region_code order by ie.region_code

select null as item_id, null as report_id, 'SALARY_PAYMENT' as item_category, sb.dispatch_enterprise_name as item_name, sb.batch_no as item_dimension, sum(sb.total_person_count) as metric_count, sum(sb.total_paid_amount) as metric_value, case when sum(ifnull(sd.total_count, 0)) = 0 then 0 else round(sum(ifnull(sd.success_count, 0)) / sum(ifnull(sd.total_count, 0)) * 100, 2) end as metric_rate, 0 as sort_no from t_salary_batch sb left join ( select batch_id, count(1) as total_count, sum(case when pay_status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as success_count from t_salary_detail where del_flag = '0' group by batch_id ) sd on sd.batch_id = sb.batch_id where sb.stat_month = #{statMonth} and sb.del_flag = '0'
and sb.region_code like concat(#{regionPrefix}, '%')
group by sb.dispatch_enterprise_id, sb.dispatch_enterprise_name, sb.batch_no order by sb.dispatch_enterprise_name

select null as item_id, null as report_id, 'EMPLOYMENT' as item_category, employer_enterprise_name as item_name, employer_enterprise_name as item_dimension, sum(ifnull(dispatch_count, 0)) as metric_count, cast(sum(ifnull(formal_count, 0)) as decimal(16,2)) as metric_value, round(avg(ifnull(ratio_value, 0)), 2) as metric_rate, 0 as sort_no from t_employment_proportion where stat_month = #{statMonth} and del_flag = '0'
and region_code like concat(#{regionPrefix}, '%')
group by employer_enterprise_id, employer_enterprise_name order by metric_rate desc, employer_enterprise_name

select null as item_id, null as report_id, 'ATTENDANCE' as item_category, dispatch_enterprise_name as item_name, dispatch_enterprise_name as item_dimension, count(1) as metric_count, cast(sum(ifnull(total_hours, 0)) as decimal(16,2)) as metric_value, case when count(1) = 0 then 0 else round(sum(case when att_check = '1' then 1 else 0 end) / count(1) * 100, 2) end as metric_rate, 0 as sort_no from t_attendance_monthly where stat_month = #{statMonth} and del_flag = '0'
and region_code like concat(#{regionPrefix}, '%')
